description: One call for "is anything wrong right now?" across running deployments, instead of checking them one by one: counts by status, the deployments in error with their error detail, ones stuck starting for over 10 minutes, and totals per location and per version with unhealthy ones flagged. check_crashes: true also reads each deployment's crash data (restarts, exit codes). Covers what Edgegap still lists: stopped deployments are gone, so this is current state, not history. Inspects up to 100 deployments per call, newest first. Read-only. Next: edgegap_search_deployment_logs for what the errors say, edgegap_compare_versions for a rollback decision.

check_crashes.description: Also read crash data (restart count, exit code) per deployment. Default false.

name: edgegap_fleet_health
title: Summarise the health of running deployments
